run_train_pipeline: run the fairseq training pipeline with a config file and databin using argparse CLI
train_fairseq_model: train a fairseq translation model with GPU auto-scaling and update frequency configuration
eval_bleu_score: evaluate a fairseq model checkpoint and return the BLEU score for a test subset
translate_with_model: translate monolingual data using a trained fairseq model with beam search and length penalty
build_backtranslation_databin: build a back-translation databin by preprocessing synthetic translations with fairseq-preprocess
